source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: IndianOil Kotak caps restored to the unit Kotak publishes them in. An earlier pass converted them to rupees at Rs.0.20/point while the rules were cashback_pct; PR #17 retyped those rules to points_per_spend to restore the Rs.150 block, and usedAgainstCap reads the cap in whatever unit the rule earns in - so 1200 points had become '240 points' and the fuel cap was exhausting at Rs.1,500 instead of Rs.7,500. MITC 12.2(b) 1200 RP fuel, 12.2(c) 800 RP shared across dining AND grocery - the two rules now carry a byte-identical rule_name so they land in one cap bucket. Also drops the 'IndianOil XTRAREWARDS' redemption row, which appears nowhere in Kotak's own documents.
